component.name: Zhell
component.summary: Fast GPU terminal that remembers every command and never loses a session

description.p: Zhell is a GPU-rendered terminal for Linux and Windows. Every command and its output becomes a block you can copy, fold, rerun or share; everything you ran is kept in a searchable local history; and your shells keep running when the window closes.

ul.li: Command blocks with exit codes and durations, sticky headers and jump-to-command
Full-text history of every command and its output, with secrets redacted first
Sessions survive closing the window, crashes and updates
Tabs, splits, several windows and a drop-down mode
Copy mode with vim keys and quick select for URLs, paths and hashes
Shell integration that also works over SSH
Glass transparency, background images and live shader backgrounds, 10 themes
No accounts, no cloud, no telemetry

screenshot.caption: Command blocks with exit status and duration
